name: Rowshon Ara Sarker
title: Community Organizer • Activist • Film Director • Writer
bio: Award-winning Film Director and Writer born in Sirajgonj, Bangladesh. Rowshon is an International Emmy® winner, activist, and Bronx Community & Housing Justice Organizer at DRUM (Desis Rising Up & Moving). Her cinematic work reflects the lived realities of working-class and immigrant communities.
